name: CSO_SCHML_METRICS_VALUES
description: This table stores the ranking metrics for the metrics defined in cso_schml_job_tracker table.

columns.name: METRICS_VALUE_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: METRICS_TYPE_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the metrics type in cso_schml_job_tracker table.

columns.name: SEARCH_CONFIGURATION_ID
columns.description: This refers to the algorithm used for performing search.

columns.name: WINDOW
columns.description: This is the time window considered for calculating the metric.

columns.name: METRIC_VALUE
columns.description: This is the calculated metric value.

columns.name: FROM_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the start date and time of the window used for calculating the metric.

columns.name: TO_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the end date and time of the window used for calculating the metric.

columns.name: NUM_TXN_IDS
columns.description: This gives the number of search transaction ids used for calculating the metric.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.
